summary: Frontend-only verification of the Grade K-3 'My Jobs' dashboard card correction. All 6 acceptance criteria pass. Seeded 3 payday jobs ('Walk the dog','Water the plants','Set the table') + 1 family job ('Feed the fish') on blank_wallet_child, confirmed each payday job renders with its contextual emoji (🐕🌱🍽️), no 'Claim' button/badge, no 'Made by you' text, and a properly outlined 'See all my jobs' button (class: border-2 border-[#1A1A1A] rounded-xl px-4 py-2 ...). Family job 'Feed the fish' correctly excluded from dashboard card but present on /my-jobs full page. Clicking 'See all my jobs' navigates to /my-jobs where both payday and family jobs are visible. Empty state (0 payday, 1 family) still shows the correct 'Jobs are things you do to earn money. Add your first one.' message + 'Add a job' outlined button, and family job stays hidden. classmate_g1 (Grade 1, classroom) and classmate_g3 (Grade 3, classroom) both correctly render leaderboard branch (no 'My jobs' card). classmate_g4_qa (Grade 4) loads its unchanged older dashboard (Learn nav present). All seeded jobs were deleted at end of test.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.jsx is 1013 lines — beyond 700-line guideline; would benefit from extracting the K-3 dashboard sections (jobs card, nav grid, hero, savings goal, bottom nav) into separate components for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: Temporarily created 3 payday jobs + 1 family job on blank_wallet_child via POST /api/child/jobs; all deleted at test end via DELETE /api/child/jobs/{job_id}. No residual data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The K-3 'My jobs' card at Dashboard.jsx ~L590-637 now shows ONLY payday_jobs (max 3, with contextual emojis via getJobEmoji helper) + an outlined 'See all my jobs' Link-styled-as-button to /my-jobs. Empty state trigger is payday_jobs.length===0 (family_jobs.length is ignored). Classroom branch (hasClassroom) still shows leaderboard unchanged. Grade 4+ dashboard is a separate code path and untouched.
rca of the issue: N/A — this was a verification round, no defects found.
